decisions.reason: Locates the exact break in index.js (inject ["apiProxy"] and ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers()) and the deleted @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy dependency in package.json, maps it to DSH-0.1.2-A1-01 with real mechanism: service-key removal causes a pending-service stall, llm.providers splits into llm/listProviders + llm/listConfigurableProviders, and the host-plane fix is injecting the llm domain service rather than "remote". Citations audit-valid; far more than a card name.

Each of the other six categories gets a no-hit conclusion backed by named scanned files and concrete pattern lists. session-notes.js is correctly identified as pure string/array utilities with the "session" filename as a red herring, and cordis.patch.yml is correctly classified as ordinary plugin composition rather than a host-source patch, with the naming distinction stated but not overclaimed.

Explicitly answers that zero hits cannot establish compatibility: the scan only covers a fixed pattern set, renamed seams and transitive/wire behavior can slip through, and dependencies/config/runtime need separate evidence. It uses the plugin itself as the counterexample, separating the decisive apiProxy break from the six negative categories.

Proposes post-migration build/typecheck, an isolated-profile cold boot on the target version checking for pending-service rows, and a real provider call (llm.listProviders() through the injected domain service), clearly framed as proposed checks not executed in this static fixture.
